beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Rohan's scared of debt. I borrow on purpose.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: Two loans, four checks. The last one is the rule the rich live by.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: My loan: $40,000 for a car, at an assumed 8%. Interest alone: $10,496.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: After 6 years? Dents, rust, and it's worth $15,086.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: I borrowed $100,000 at an assumed 6%, for a shop building. Interest: $33,225.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Tenants pay rent. The value climbs. At an assumed 8%, it's $215,892 in 10 years.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: Both are debt. One sinks you. One lifts you.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: My loan cost $33,225. The building gained $115,892. I keep the gap.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Poor people borrow for things that shrink. Rich people borrow for things that grow. If it stops growing, it's just debt.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Me? Still scared of debt. Well, my kind.
